intent: A login screen for an internal admin dashboard used by ~40 staff. Email + password only; Google sign-in is a nice-to-have for later. 'Forgot password' sends a reset email. No sign-up (accounts are provisioned by IT). Stack is already decided: Next.js + Supabase auth. The sticky note about mobile means the form must be usable on phones, but there is no separate mobile design.

mustAsk: who the users are or what the app behind the login is
what 'Forgot password?' does or where it leads
what the Google button does (nice-to-have vs required)
